verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a single line on the Iceberg tables docs page citing "Time travel for historical data access in BigQuery." That supports querying past data, but only thinly, and possibly only for Iceberg managed tables. Nothing in the pack covers restoring dropped or corrupted tables from history. missing for 10: documented point-in-time query syntax for standard tables, restore/undelete of dropped tables, recovery of corrupted tables, retention-window details, independent or hands-on corroboration
